_classes.name: Conditions/limits of the local-law tax power stored as records (litigation joinder proviso; 3-year duration limit on each local law)
_classes.rule: re.search(r'shall be joined as a party|for a period of time no longer than', quote, re.I)
_classes.note: 10 joinder + 14 duration-limit matches. Joinder: 'the commissioner of finance ... shall be joined as a party in any action or proceeding brought to collect the tax by the owner' binds the private plaintiff, not the officer.

_classes.name: Title or pronoun substitution only ('[tax commission] {{commissioner}}', '[it] {{he or she}}') stored as an extends_existing record
_classes.rule: map quote into packet post-amendment text (brackets removed, whitespace collapsed, brace mask kept); flag when every new-matter word in the quote span is in {commissioner, he, or, she, his, her, him, chairperson, chair, the, such, department, superintendent, person, individual} and at least one of he/she/commissioner/chairperson; script /tmp/auditB_20261027/s/c2b.py
_classes.note: Recurrence of the Oct 17 gender-word-only reprint class, extended to office-name substitutions; the reprinted_gender_neutral gate did not catch these.

_classes.name: sunset_extension_from_title holder taken from another Part of an omnibus act clause, quote not trimmed to 60 words
_classes.rule: record_source=='sunset_extension_from_title' and re.search(r'\(Part [A-Z]', signed.act_clause)  [omnibus]; companion: record_source=='sunset_extension_from_title' and len(quote.split())>60
_classes.note: Holder 'the city of New York' comes from Part D's title words ('tax on tobacco products, city of New York'); the sentences are Part C racing-law sunsets. Companion rule (>60 words) matches 23 records, e.g. 2009-A7328-04.

_classes.name: OTB holder stored under an ad hoc label 'Off-track Betting Corporation Branch Offices' instead of the regional off-track betting corporations
One-time installation duty with no stated deadline stored as deadline none (should be on_effective_date)
_classes.rule: file duties and deadline_kind=='none' and deliverable_type=='signage or installation' and recurrence=='one-time' (misses 'installed and maintained' records stored ongoing, e.g. 2017-S5570-03)

_classes.name: Named State commission filed under the group 'State authorities'
_classes.rule: agency=='State authorities' and re.search(r'commission (on|for|of) ', actor_raw, re.I)

_classes.name: Locality name casing broken after a hyphen ('Hastings-on-hudson')
Stated future appointment date ('on and after July first in the year next succeeding ...') stored as on_effective_date
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' and re.search(r'on and after|next succeeding|no later than [A-Za-z]+ (first|\d)|on or before [A-Za-z]+ (first|\d)', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: Salary entitlement of board members stored as a duty (known class, recurrence)
Missed earlier-chapter sunset extensions with no holder in the sentence (Oct 19 rule) and a missed narrowed duty
